source.organization: General Authority of Islamic Affairs, Endowments and Zakat
source.methodology: Total numbers of Zakat calculation requests classified by service delivery channel and month

indicator.name: Zakat Calculation Request Service Statistics
indicator.definition: A report reviewing the number of customers by channel and month

website.description: Number of Zakat calculation requests submitted via the Authority's website

smartphone_app.description: Number of requests submitted via the Authority's smartphone application

mobile_website.description: Number of requests submitted via the Authority's mobile website (smartphone browser)

zaki_platform.description: Number of requests submitted via the Authority's WhatsApp service (Zaki) at 8008222

call_center.description: Number of requests submitted via the Authority's call center (8008222)

service_center.original_name: Service Delivery Center / مركز تقديم الخدمة
service_center.description: Number of requests submitted in person at the Authority's service delivery center

na_legacy.description: Transactions documented on a channel that was subsequently cancelled (legacy/deprecated)

ivr.description: Number of requests via Interactive Voice Response (used in 2022-2023 only)

sms.description: Number of requests via SMS messages (used in 2022-2023 only)

total.description: Total Zakat calculation requests across all channels for the given month

terms.definition: Number of Zakat calculation requests submitted
Refers to a channel that was cancelled but a transaction was documented before cancellation.
Direct channels, whether in person or by phone
Electronic channels on the website or other electronic services (Kiosk, etc.)
Smart channels through smartphones, whether an app, mobile website, SMS, etc.
The month in which the service was provided.
